summary: Recurring disaster-recovery assurance plus a Monitoring Forward Power display fix. Nightly backups verify pg_restore catalogs, record Git cleanliness, and write nonsecret receipts; an optional weekly remote verifier and read-only backup check are included. Cobalt Forward Power displays the worst of its numeric and paired RF-indicator states without changing probes, alerts, or native TX300 behavior. Nightly timer unchanged; one additive choices-only migration; no protected-runtime change.
